ops.name: app
ops.doc: Application root. Children: theme, data, state, page, component.

ops.name: theme
ops.doc: Design token declarations.

ops.name: token
ops.doc: A named design token, referenced as $name in color/size positions.

ops.name: data
ops.doc: Data declarations. Children: resource.

ops.name: resource
ops.doc: Async HTTP resource with data/loading/error states. :poll n re-fetches every n seconds; :live true re-fetches on server db changes (SSE).

ops.name: state
ops.doc: App-level shared state, readable across pages and components.

ops.name: local
ops.doc: Component- or page-local state.

ops.name: page
ops.doc: A routed page. Route templates use {param} segments; :title sets document.title.

ops.name: component
ops.doc: A reusable component. First child may be a (props ...) form.

ops.name: props
ops.doc: Component prop declarations: (props (name string) (on-buy action)).

ops.name: use
ops.doc: JavaScript interop: (use "pkg-or-./path" (import name [jsName]) (import-default name)).

ops.name: db
ops.doc: Database schema: (db (table name (col type ...)...) (seed table (row ...)...)). Compiles to SQLite behind the generated API server.

ops.name: table
ops.doc: Table declaration inside (db ...): columns are (name auto|string|number|boolean [:default v] [:optional true] [:indexed true] [:references other-table]).

ops.name: seed
ops.doc: Seed rows inside (db ...): (seed table (row :col value ...) ...). Applied when the table is empty (and after each test reset).

ops.name: row
ops.doc: One seed row inside (seed ...): (row :col literal ...).

ops.name: api
ops.doc: HTTP API: (api (get "/api/x" handler) (post "/api/x" [:auth true] (input (name string)...) handler) ...). Handlers are expressions over route params, body, user (with :auth), fns, and db ops.

ops.name: input
ops.doc: Request-body contract inside an api route: (input (name string|number|boolean [:optional true :min n :max n :integer true :min-len n :max-len n :format email|uuid|url]) ...). Validated at check time against (send ...) and at runtime (400 on mismatch).

ops.name: auth
ops.doc: Session auth: (auth users [:provider "./identity.ts"]). Provides POST /api/auth/signup|login|logout|logout-all and GET /api/auth/me; routes marked :auth true see a `user` row.

ops.name: enum
ops.doc: Named value set: (enum status open closed). Members read as strings via status.open; (match ...) over an enum-typed state is exhaustiveness-checked.

ops.name: env
ops.doc: Server config from the environment: (env stripe-key [:default ""]). Read in api handlers as env.stripe-key; the server validates presence at startup.

ops.name: job
ops.doc: Recurring server task: (job prune :every 3600 expr). Body is one server expression (db ops, fns, env) run every :every seconds.

ops.name: uploads
ops.doc: Uploads: :max-kb (default 5120), :public (default false with auth), :quota-mb (1024), :user-quota-mb (100). Private files require their owner session. Pair with file-input.

ops.name: i18n
ops.doc: Message catalogs: (i18n (locale en (msg key "text {param}")...) (locale fr ...)). The first locale is the default; read with (t key :param expr). Declare (state locale "en") to switch at runtime.

ops.name: locale
ops.doc: One locale inside (i18n ...); children are (msg key "text") forms.

ops.name: msg
ops.doc: One message inside (locale ...): {param} placeholders fill from (t key :param v).

ops.name: dark
ops.doc: Dark-scheme token overrides inside (theme ...): applied under prefers-color-scheme: dark.

ops.name: fn
ops.doc: Pure function: (fn name (param...) body-expr). Recursion allowed; body may use params, other fns, and imports (not state).

ops.name: import
ops.doc: Named import inside (use ...). jsName defaults to the camelCased name.

ops.name: import-default
ops.doc: Default import inside (use ...).

ops.name: include
ops.doc: Splice another .grhm file (app-level forms) into the app.

ops.name: vstack
ops.doc: Vertical stack.

ops.name: hstack
ops.doc: Horizontal stack.

ops.name: grid
ops.doc: CSS grid with a column count.

ops.name: section
ops.doc: Semantic section landmark.

ops.name: scroll
ops.doc: Scrollable region.

ops.name: card
ops.doc: Card container with sensible default chrome.

ops.name: spacer
ops.doc: Fixed or flexible space.

ops.name: text
ops.doc: Inline text; positional parts are concatenated.

ops.name: heading
ops.doc: Heading (level 1-6, default 1).

ops.name: image
ops.doc: Image. Provide :alt for accessibility.

ops.name: link
ops.doc: In-app navigation link.

ops.name: list
ops.doc: Unordered list; each child renders as a list item.

ops.name: money
ops.doc: Localized currency amount.

ops.name: skeleton
ops.doc: Loading placeholder: shimmering bars (:lines 1–100, default 3). Show while a resource is loading.

ops.name: form
ops.doc: Form; attach a (submit ...) child, which prevents default submission.

ops.name: dialog
ops.doc: Modal dialog controlled by an :open boolean state reference.

ops.name: tabs
ops.doc: Tab strip; children are (tab "Label" body...) forms. :value state is optional.

ops.name: tab
ops.doc: One tab panel inside (tabs ...).

ops.name: menu
ops.doc: Dropdown menu; children are (item "Label" action...) forms.

ops.name: item
ops.doc: One activatable entry inside (menu ...).

ops.name: table
ops.doc: Data table: (table row items (col "Header" cell...) ...).

ops.name: col
ops.doc: One column inside (table ...); children render in each row cell.

ops.name: button
ops.doc: Button; attach behavior with a (click ...) child.

ops.name: input
ops.doc: Text input, two-way bound to :value state. Native validation via :required/:pattern/:min/:max/:min-len/:max-len; :error renders an inline message when truthy.

ops.name: file-input
ops.doc: File picker: uploads the chosen file and writes its URL into :to (string state). Requires (uploads ...).

ops.name: checkbox
ops.doc: Checkbox, two-way bound to :checked state.

ops.name: select
ops.doc: Select, two-way bound to :value; :options is a list expression.

ops.name: each
ops.doc: Repeat children for every item of a list expression.

ops.name: if
ops.doc: Conditional: (if cond then-element else-element?); cond must be boolean.

ops.name: when
ops.doc: Render children only when the boolean condition holds.

ops.name: slot
ops.doc: Renders the children passed to a component instance.

ops.name: click
ops.doc: Click handler; children are actions run in order.

ops.name: change
ops.doc: Change handler for inputs.

ops.name: submit
ops.doc: Submit handler.

ops.name: set
ops.doc: Assign a new value to writable state.

ops.name: nav
ops.doc: Navigate to a route: a string or a (path ...) form.

ops.name: path
ops.doc: Route template with named params: (path "/products/{id}" :id p.id).

ops.name: toast
ops.doc: Show a transient notification: (toast "Saved" :tone success). Announced via a polite live region.

ops.name: try
ops.doc: Run actions, jumping to the trailing (catch actions...) child on failure: (try (send ...) (refresh r) (catch (toast "Failed" :tone error))).

ops.name: catch
ops.doc: Failure branch inside (try ...).

ops.name: tests
ops.doc: Top-level browser test suite; children are (test "name" step...) forms.

ops.name: test
ops.doc: One browser test; steps: visit, click, fill, expect-text, expect-node, expect-url.

to-num.doc: (to-num x) -> number, or null when Number(x) is NaN (non-numeric strings, records)

slice.doc: (slice start end x), strings and lists

reduce.doc: (reduce f init xs), f takes (acc x)

from-entries.doc: (from-entries pairs) -> record; later duplicate keys win

assoc.doc: (assoc record key value) -> new record with an own field; original unchanged

dissoc.doc: (dissoc record key) -> new record without the own field

merge.doc: (merge record ...) -> new record; later own fields win

has-key.doc: (has-key record key) -> boolean; ignores inherited properties

json-parse.doc: (json-parse text) -> unknown JSON value; invalid JSON throws; guard with attempt

json-stringify.doc: (json-stringify value) -> compact JSON string; an undefined top-level value becomes "null"

flat-map.doc: (flat-map f xs) -> concatenated callback results, flattened one level

flatten.doc: (flatten xs) -> new list flattened one level

unique.doc: (unique xs) -> first occurrences; SameValueZero comparison, records compare by identity

zip.doc: (zip xs ys) -> pairs, stopping at the shorter list

chunk.doc: (chunk positive-integer xs) -> consecutive lists, final chunk may be shorter; invalid size throws; guard with attempt

group-by.doc: (group-by key-fn xs) -> record of lists keyed by String(key-fn item)

regex-test.doc: (regex-test pattern text [flags]) -> boolean; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt

regex-find.doc: (regex-find pattern text [flags]) -> full match and capture strings, or null; unmatched captures are undefined; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt

regex-replace.doc: (regex-replace pattern replacement text [flags]) -> string; flags default to g; invalid pattern/flags throw; guard with attempt

url-decode.doc: (url-decode text) -> decoded URL component; malformed escapes throw; guard with attempt

date-iso.doc: (date-iso epoch-ms) -> UTC ISO 8601 string; invalid date throws; guard with attempt

date-parse.doc: (date-parse text) -> epoch milliseconds, or null when unparseable; prefer ISO 8601 input

sign.doc: numeric sign, preserving zero and NaN

or-else.doc: (or-else x fallback), fallback when x is null/undefined

attempt.doc: (attempt expr fallback), fallback if expr throws

match.doc: (match x (literal value)... (else value)); exhaustive over enums

select.doc: (select table [:where cond] [:order col] [:desc true] [:limit n] [:offset n]) -> rows; :where compiles to SQL over column refs

fail.doc: (fail status "message") -> abort the handler with an HTTP error

tx.doc: (tx expr) -> run expr inside a transaction, rolling back on failure

diagnostics.E001: Lexical error (bad character, escape, or unterminated string)
diagnostics.E004: Compiler source, token, or nesting budget exceeded; split or simplify the source
diagnostics.E104: Invalid positional arguments (wrong count or type)
diagnostics.E105: Keyword property is missing a value
diagnostics.E110: Form is not allowed in this position
diagnostics.E202: Target of set is not writable state
diagnostics.E203: Navigation target does not match any route
diagnostics.E204: Invalid resource field (allowed: data, loading, error)
diagnostics.W301: Resource data read without acknowledging loading/error states
diagnostics.E501: Patch target or property not found
diagnostics.E503: Patch or fix would produce an invalid program
diagnostics.W601: Unchecked interop call (validated only by TypeScript at build time)
diagnostics.W602: Interop package not installed in node_modules
diagnostics.E603: Include could not be resolved (missing file, cycle, unsafe path, or project budget)
diagnostics.E806: send targets no declared api route
diagnostics.E808: Unknown or invalid request body field
diagnostics.E809: send body does not match the route input contract
diagnostics.E810: insert is missing a required column
diagnostics.E811: Invalid select query (:where/:order must use table columns)
diagnostics.W701: Message key missing from a non-default locale
diagnostics.E816: :live requires the generated API server (a db or api declaration)
diagnostics.E818: Invalid uploads declaration or file-input without (uploads ...)
diagnostics.W801: Operation may throw at runtime; wrap in (attempt expr fallback)

specialForms.name: call
specialForms.doc: (call target.path arg...) — interop invocation; browser globals: window document console localStorage sessionStorage navigator location history fetch alert confirm prompt

specialForms.name: lambda
specialForms.doc: (lambda (x) expr) — anonymous function, usable wherever a function is expected.

specialForms.name: let
specialForms.doc: (let ((x e1) (y e2)) body) — sequential local bindings, an expression.

specialForms.name: if
specialForms.doc: (if cond then else) — in expression position, a value-producing conditional.

specialForms.name: send
specialForms.doc: (send post|put|delete "/route-or-(path ...)" :prop expr...) — JSON mutation; must match a declared api route.

specialForms.name: refresh
specialForms.doc: (refresh resource-name) — re-fetch a resource after a mutation.
